answer: Anchor each agent to one residential broadband line: the ISP signs a certificate binding the account to a single physical connection, checked at registration, with duplicates rejected and annual re-verification. A farm of 10,000 fake agents then needs 10,000 real lines — $40 a month each, $400,000 monthly, plus $60 install fees and 30 days of waiting per line, and a sold certificate is revoked within 24 hours. Like dawn breaking over a field, the fakes cannot hide; the network sips real nectar, not syrup, and every duplicate line leaves an echo the registry hears instantly.
